spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes public eBay behavior for the whole workspace. A live save ends eBay listings in the background, and an ended listing is not relisted by this tool. Only the workspace owner may call it, and the agent saves bands only after the seller chose them.
A live save answers agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while SpellBook has agent marketplace writes switched off. A dry run always works.

A copy with no market price keeps its current state and is counted under noMarketPrice. A variation-package listing is evaluated as a package, and liveListings.loseCopies counts the copies that would leave their listing.

Widened bands reach new copies on the next hourly automatic listing pass. The response reports enforcementActive, which is a fact about the saved policy, not proof that every out-of-band listing has already ended.

Counts use today's market price. Enforcement also applies an anchor-collapse guard that holds a sharply fallen price at its recent level, so a copy near a band edge can stay or end differently than counted.
Each call reads every live eBay copy of the workspace and can take up to about 20 seconds on a store with 24,000 live copies. The response returns facts and never ranks bands or recommends one.

description: Preview or save per-game eBay price bands, each a market price range in USD. With dryRun true it saves nothing and returns, per game, how many live eBay copies and listings the bands would keep, end, or leave because they have no market price. With dryRun false it saves the bands and returns the same counts: SpellBook Finance then ends live eBay copies whose market price falls outside their game's bands, in the background and again in a daily sweep, and keeps out-of-band copies off eBay. A live save needs no dry run first. Only the workspace owner may call it, and the agent saves bands only after the seller chose them.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

dryRun.description: true previews and saves nothing. false saves. Required.

previewFingerprint.description: Optional and ignored. Older clients sent the previewFingerprint from a dry run here.

priceBands.description: Bands per game id, such as mtg, pokemon, or riftbound. Each band is {minUsd, maxUsd} in USD of market price, with maxUsd null for no upper limit. A copy stays when its market price is at or above minUsd and below maxUsd. A game with an empty list, or absent, has no restriction. This replaces every saved band, so send every game that should keep one. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose eBay price bands to set. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_price_bands_set
